creators.name: Dave Portnoy — Barstool 'One Bite' pizza reviews; Nov 2025 Cincinnati pizza tour
creators.credible: FOX19 documented his Nov 2025 Cincinnati One Bite tour of five pizzerias (Adriatico's, Taglio, Guardia, Trophy, St. Francis Apizza); St. Francis Apizza scored 8.2 — the highest One Bite score of any pizzeria in Ohio. Findable content: onebite.app Cincinnati reviews + FOX19 recaps.

creators.name: Stefan Johnson (@s_johnson_voiceovers) — viral TikTok food reviews; Cincinnati chili-parlor tour
creators.credible: Voice actor turned viral food-review creator; made city-specific Cincinnati content — a dedicated Camp Washington Chili video (tiktok video 7429443957513293102) and a Cincinnati chili-tour video reviewing Skyline/Gold Star/Camp Washington (7419405277805432107, ~46K likes). Note: Cleveland-based, but this content is scoped to Cincinnati itself, not the region.

creators.name: Kait Lott (@kaitskravings) — Cincinnati food influencer, Queen City eats
creators.credible: Cincinnati Magazine profile ('Kait Lott Knows What You Crave'); Cincinnati-based food creator highlighting local restaurants and Queen City culinary developments.

creators.name: Dione Wu (@drinkingdiningdione) — Cincinnati foodie, dining-scene reels
creators.credible: Cincinnati Magazine profile ('Dione Wu Cooks Up Aesthetically Pleasing Food Photos'); ranked #5 among Cincinnati food & drink Instagram influencers (infludata, Mar 2026). Miami University grad based in Cincinnati.

creators.name: Cincinnati Eats (@cincyeats) — Queen City restaurant/dish curation since 2014
creators.credible: Featured by Cincinnati Refined ('Foodies Will Love These 5 Local Instagrammers'); run by two local photographers, posting Cincinnati eats since 2014.

creators.name: Cincinnati Food Blog (@cincinnatifoodies) — Cincinnati food & drink content creators
creators.credible: Established Cincinnati food-and-drink IG account (~32K, 'showing you all the eats in Cincinnati, Ohio'); appears in Cincinnati food-influencer roundups (Upfluence, influData).

creators.name: Ronny Salerno — Queen City Discovery; Cincinnati urbex / weird-history photojournalist
creators.followers: ~3K social — included on AUTHORITY, not follower scale
creators.credible: Published author of 'Fading Ads of Cincinnati'; founded Queen City Discovery (2007) documenting the abandoned Cincinnati Subway, the NKY 'ghost ship', and forgotten local sites; photojournalist at Cincinnati Public Radio; profiled by Cincinnati Magazine, Cincinnati Refined and Voyage Ohio. Kept as a genuinely authoritative weird-history creator rather than a large-following one.

creators.name: Julie Niesen — 'Wine Me, Dine Me' / WVXU 'Bits & Bites'; veteran Cincinnati food writer
creators.followers: authority basis — award-winning food blog (2007–) + WVXU food columnist
creators.credible: Covered Cincinnati food since 2007–08; her 'Wine Me, Dine Me' blog was cited by The Washington Post, USA Today, Serious Eats, the Cincinnati Enquirer and CityBeat; now writes 'Bits & Bites' for Cincinnati Public Radio (WVXU). Longtime Over-the-Rhine resident.

creators.name: Christian Gill — 'Feast Mode 513' / Boomtown chef; Food Network champion
creators.followers: YouTube following NOT independently verifiable — included on AUTHORITY
creators.credible: Cincinnati chef/owner of Boomtown Biscuits & Whiskey (Pendleton); Food Network competitor and champion (won Ultimate Thanksgiving Challenge; also Beat Bobby Flay, Guy's Grocery Games); runs the 'Feast Mode 513' Cincinnati takeout-review channel (covered by Cincinnati Magazine, 2020). Note: his creator-following is not independently verifiable, so he is kept on chef/Food-Network authority, not on a claimed subscriber count.
